channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Trump says oil and gas prices won't fall until 'right after' midterm election
item.description: President Donald Trump said energy prices that have been elevated due to the Iran war will not come down until after the midterm elections.

item.title: Apple event 2026: Folding iPhone Duo, iPhone 18 Pro, added AI features and more
item.description: Apple rolled out the foldable iPhone Duo, iPhone 18 Pro and Max, Watch Series 12 and many other features and updates in its first launch under CEO John Ternus.

item.title: Experts weigh in as researcher says AI has more than 10% chance of 'killing all humans'
item.description: Jacob Coxon said in a post on X that Anthropic and OpenAI are "gambling with our lives."

item.title: Dow slides 300 points as rates jump, international crude price tops $100: Live updates
item.description: Stocks fell on Wednesday as rising Treasury yields and oil prices continued to rattle investors.

item.title: Bond sell-off, stock boom: Why rebalancing is a good strategy right now
item.description: With stocks near all-time highs and bonds selling off, it's likely a good time for investors to consider rebalancing to their target risk, advisors said.

item.title: A bullish pattern is emerging in SpaceX shares, says Frank Cappelleri
item.description: Frank Cappelleri takes a look at the technicals in the Elon Musk-led rocket name.

item.title: What a historic summer box office reveals about massive shifts in the theatrical industry
item.description: The domestic box office posted a record-breaking summer movie season, which was bolstered by an extra week of ticket sales and higher-priced premium screenings.

item.title: Signet shares soar as jeweler lifts annual profit forecast
item.description: Signet Jewelers lifted its annual profit forecast off the heels of continuing demand for luxury goods, causing shares to rise 20%.

item.title: Robinhood CEO says companies can't control how their stock is tokenized as AMC clash escalates
item.description: Robinhood's Vlad Tenev said public companies can’t control financial products built around their stock while acknowledging token holders don’t get voting rights.

item.title: What execs are talking about at Goldman Sachs' Communacopia: AI, data centers, disruption
item.description: CoreWeave CEO Mike Intrator spoke to CNBC at the Goldman Sachs' Communacopia + Technology Conference this week.

item.title: CNBC's Official NFL Team Valuations 2026: Here's how the 32 franchises stack up
item.description: The average National Football League team is now worth $10.36 billion, up 35% from a year ago.

item.title: LA Rams President Kevin Demoff touts Australia push ahead of historic NFL game
item.description: The Rams spent five years building their brand in Australia. This week, Los Angeles will face San Francisco in the NFL’s first regular-season game Down Under.

item.title: Trump's oil investments have gained millions during Iran war as his accounts keep trading
item.description: Donald Trump retained major oil and gas investments as the Iran war has moved energy markets. CNBC analyzed his holdings, trades and estimated gains.

item.title: U.S. denies claims Iran struck two American vessels in retaliation for earlier strikes
item.description: The U.S. denied Iran’s claim that it struck two American vessels as the two sides traded attacks near the Strait of Hormuz and Brent crude hit $100 a barrel.

item.title: U.S. reveals import ban on slew of Canadian goods as trade war escalates
item.description: Import bans on motorbikes, alcohol and dairy products are due to come into effect on Sept. 29 as the rift between the countries deepens.

item.title: This battered travel stock is seen as an AI victim. But the data suggests otherwise
item.description: Investors are afraid chatbots will supplant online travel agencies, but direct bookings are still on the rise.

item.title: Trump pushes Fed for lower rates, but consumers may be better off with a hike, experts say
item.description: As the Trump administration ramps up pressure on the Federal Reserve, consumers may be better served if senior officials back off, experts say.

item.title: Google to invest record $15 billion in AI infrastructure in the 'Texas of Europe'
item.description: Google on Wednesday said it would invest $15.1 billion into AI infrastructure in Finland, marking the tech giant's largest single investment in Europe.

item.title: Andreessen- and Thiel-backed defense startup opens U.S. missile factory as it exits stealth
item.description: Founded in 2024, Covenant is speeding up lower-cost missile manufacturing for the U.S. military.

item.title: These are the top 10 U.S. states for workers' rights, says new report—8 of them have a minimum wage over $15
item.description: These states provide strong minimum wages, worker protections and rights to organize, according to Oxfam's research.

item.title: LightStream and SoFi both offer personal loans up to $100,000: Which one is right for you?
item.description: LightStream may be better for longer terms, while SoFi could be a better fit for existing members who qualify for a rate discount.

item.title: Demand for riskier mortgages rises again, along with interest rates
item.description: Mortgage rates continue to climb, so more borrowers are turning to adjustable rate mortgages, which offer lower interest rates comparatively.

item.title: How much does it cost to move a midterm prediction market? Not much
item.description: Interested parties could seek to move prediction markets to give a perceived boost to a candidate who is struggling to gain momentum or attention.
